welcome.title: Welcome to Firebase Editor Pro
welcome.intro: To get started, import the key.json file of a service account from your Firebase project.
welcome.step1: In the Firebase console open Project settings > Service accounts.
welcome.step2: Click "Generate new private key" and save the JSON file.
welcome.step3: Import it here. The credential is stored only in your system keychain (or the browser's local storage).

connection.disconnectBody: The stored credential will be deleted. You will need to import the key.json again to reconnect.

errors.keyInvalid: The key.json file is not valid: {{detail}}
errors.keyUnreadable: The private key in the file could not be read. Make sure it is the original key.json.
errors.rejected: Google rejected the credential. Check that the key has not been revoked and that the file is the right one.
errors.offline: Offline: could not reach Google. Check your internet connection and retry.
errors.forbidden: Permission denied: the service account is missing a required IAM role or the Firestore API is not enabled in Google Cloud. Grant the role (for example Cloud Datastore User) or enable the API, then retry.
errors.unknown: Unexpected error. The technical details show what the system reported.
errors.fileRead: The selected file could not be read.

keyReason.notObject: it must contain a JSON object
keyReason.badPem: field "{{field}}" is not a PEM PKCS#8 key

api.offline: No connection: Google could not be reached. Check your internet connection and retry.
api.unauthenticated: Google rejected the credential (401). The service account key may have been revoked or disabled. Disconnect and import a valid key.json.
api.forbidden: Permission denied (403). The service account is missing a required IAM role (for example Cloud Datastore User for Firestore, or Firebase Remote Config Admin for Remote Config) or the API is not enabled in Google Cloud. Grant the role or enable the API in the Google Cloud console, then retry.
api.notFound: Not found (404): the item does not exist (it may have been deleted or the version is no longer available).
api.rateLimited: Google is limiting requests (429). Wait a moment and retry.
api.server: Google had a temporary problem (5xx). Retry in a few moments.

errors.offlineBanner: You are offline. Changes in the editor are kept; actions will work again when the connection returns.

firestore.missingHint: This document has no fields; it only exists as the parent of subcollections.
firestore.selectDocument: Select a document to view it.
firestore.documentMissing: This document does not exist. It may have been deleted, or it only exists as the parent of subcollections.

editor.duplicateField: A field with that name already exists.
editor.actionFailed: The JSON could not be processed.
editor.tableNeedsValidJson: The table view needs valid JSON. Fix the JSON in the JSON view first.
editor.invalidBlocked: Saving is blocked until the document is valid.
editor.saveFailed: Could not save: {{message}}. Your changes are still in the editor.
editor.conflictBody: The document changed in Firestore since you opened it. Reload discards your local changes and loads the current version. Force saves your version anyway.
editor.forceWarning: This will save without checking for newer changes and may overwrite them.

errors.arrayInArray: {{path}}: Firestore does not support an array directly inside an array. Wrap the inner array in a map.
errors.unknownType: {{path}}: unknown value type in a __type__ tag.
errors.invalidNumber: {{path}}: this number cannot be stored in Firestore.
errors.invalidValue: The document must be a JSON object.

crud.createCollectionHint: In Firestore a collection exists once it has its first document: that document will be created.
crud.documentIdHint: Leave empty to generate an automatic ID.
crud.documentIdInvalid: The document ID cannot contain "/" or be "." or "..".
crud.alreadyExists: A document already exists at {{path}}. It was not overwritten.
crud.deleteDocBody: You are about to permanently delete the document {{path}}. This cannot be undone.
crud.deleteCollBody_one: You are about to permanently delete the collection {{path}}: {{count}} document will be deleted in total (including subcollections and missing parent documents). This cannot be undone.
crud.deleteCollBody_other: You are about to permanently delete the collection {{path}}: {{count}} documents will be deleted in total (including subcollections and missing parent documents). This cannot be undone.
crud.deleteCollNested: Deep delete: all subcollections and their documents are removed too, along with parent documents that only exist because they have subcollections. The count covers the whole subtree.

io.exportCancelled: Export cancelled: no file was saved.
io.targetHintDoc: If a document already exists at this path it is replaced.
io.targetHintColl: Existing documents with the same ID are replaced; nothing else is deleted.
io.empty: Choose a file or paste JSON first.

fileErrors.file_read_failed: it may not exist or you may lack permission.
fileErrors.file_write_failed: check the destination folder and your permissions.
fileErrors.file_not_regular: the chosen path is not a regular file.
fileErrors.file_too_large: the file exceeds the 32 MiB limit.
fileErrors.file_not_utf8: the file is not valid UTF-8 text.

errors.badId: Invalid document or collection ID "{{id}}" in {{path}}.
errors.reservedKey: {{path}}: the "{{key}}" key is reserved for collection imports and is not allowed in a single document.

rc.emptyHint: This template has no parameters yet. Add them to the "parameters" key and publish.
rc.formatFailed: The JSON could not be formatted because it is not valid.
rc.publishBlocked: Publishing is blocked until the template is valid:
rc.validationOk: The template is valid. Nothing was published.
rc.validationServer: Remote Config rejected the template. The technical details show the reason Google gave.
rc.validationConflict: The template changed in Remote Config since you loaded it. Reload it or publish to resolve the conflict.

issues.invalidJson: The JSON is not valid. The technical details show where it fails.
issues.notObject: The template must be a JSON object.
issues.conditionalValuesNotObject: "conditionalValues" of parameter "{{param}}" must be an object.
issues.unknownCondition: Parameter "{{param}}" uses the condition "{{condition}}" in conditionalValues, but that condition does not exist in "conditions".

rc.publishBody: The whole template is replaced and a new version is created. Parameters you did not touch are kept as they are.
rc.publishFailed: Could not publish: {{message}}. Your edits are still in the editor.
rc.conflictTitle: The template changed in Remote Config
rc.conflictBody: Someone published a newer template since you loaded it, so nothing was published. Reload brings the current template and re-applies your edits to it. Force publishes your template anyway and replaces the newer one.
rc.forceWarning: This publishes your template without checking for newer changes and may overwrite them.
rc.reapplied_one: Template reloaded and {{count}} edit re-applied. Review it before publishing.
rc.reapplied_other: Template reloaded and {{count}} edits re-applied. Review them before publishing.
rc.overridden: These entries were also changed in Remote Config; your version was kept: {{names}}.
rc.reloadConfirmBody: Reloading replaces the editor content with the template currently in Remote Config. Your unpublished edits will be lost.
rc.rollbackBody: Version {{version}} will be restored and published as a new version. The history is kept.
rc.rollbackDirty: Your unpublished edits in the editor will be discarded.
rc.defaultsCancelled: Download cancelled: no file was saved.
